bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
policy=/home/admin1/.config/debugai-gitops/delegations/policies/dlg_master_debugai_v1.json
printf 'TRUST_POLICY_READABLE='; test -r "$policy" && echo YES || echo NO
if test -r "$policy"; then
 jq -c '{id,enabled,revoked,allowed_operations,allowed_scopes,benchmark_path_allowed:(.allowed_paths|index("server/control/model-ab-benchmark.js")!=null)}' "$policy"
fi
printf 'HOST_USER=';id -un
printf 'SUDO_PASSWORDLESS=';sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo YES || echo NO
printf 'SOURCE_REFLECT_SOCKET=';if test -S /run/gace/servercore-source-reflect.sock; then stat -c '%a:%U:%G' /run/gace/servercore-source-reflect.sock;else echo ABSENT;fi
printf 'SOURCE_REFLECT_SERVICE='; systemctl is-active gace-servercore-source-reflect.service 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'REPO_BRANCH=';git -C /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai branch --show-current
printf 'REPO_REMOTE=';git -C /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai remote get-url origin
